name: Dehya
notes: Both sources give three builds: an off-field support or sub-DPS (HP% and EM; KQM first, Game8 first too), an EM Burgeon build, and an on-field Pyro DPS with 4pc Marechaussee Hunter. The card follows the first. They differ on the talent order (KQM Burst first, Game8 Skill first): the card follows KQM, as her Burst is the larger hit. The kit lines marked 'check' are ATK multipliers (some add a small Max HP part). Game8 puts 4pc Scroll first, KQM 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith. A third source, genshin.gg's Dehya page (checked 2026-10-29), calls her a support with HP% on every piece, 4pc Tenacity of the Millelith first and 4pc Instructor third, and Favonius Greatsword and Makhaira Aquamarine on its weapon list; so the card puts Tenacity first, then Scroll, then Instructor, and keeps Favonius Greatsword and Makhaira Aquamarine, which all three name, first. Neither source gives stat goals. ER 160% is the low end of KQM's Furina Vaporize and Mono Pyro or Burning ranges (160-210% and 160-180%); with Chevreuse it is 150-175%. Confidence is medium: the three sources agree on the off-field HP% support build, but the other builds differ and no goals exist.
